scripts.push: sh -c 'if [ "$NODE_ENV" = "production" ]; then echo "db:push is forbidden in production. Use migrations." >&2; exit 1; fi; echo "[DEV ONLY] Running drizzle push - NOT for production use" && drizzle-kit push --config ./drizzle.config.ts'
scripts.push-force: sh -c 'if [ "$NODE_ENV" = "production" ]; then echo "db:push is forbidden in production. Use migrations." >&2; exit 1; fi; echo "[DEV ONLY] Running drizzle push --force - NOT for production use" && drizzle-kit push --force --config ./drizzle.config.ts'
